card.name: Conflict and persecution in history narratives
card.fires_on: Small words (by, of, as well) and first digits of years in historical or fictional accounts of conflict, such as persecution, murder, blockades and battles. It fires just before the agent, victim or date is named.

modes.label: Linking word before an agent
modes.description: A small word such as by or of that comes right before the person behind a violent or hostile act.
modes.example: Ruffians had been sent<< by>> Sharkey (Saruman) to

modes.label: First digit of a year
modes.description: The opening digit of a year in a passage about riots, wars or battles.
modes.example: REBECCA RIOTS, the name given to some disturbances which occurred in <<1>>843 in the counties of Pemb

card.writes: It seems to push toward names or word starts that come next, and away from words about terror, sabotage and offense.
card.plain: It marks small words and year digits in stories of fighting or persecution, just before the name or date is given.
